trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse, shallow V-shaped depression with a wide internal angle and low vertical depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing boundary; the right lobe exhibits a prominent, deep indentation approximately midway between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature on the distal upper margins of both lobes, tapering to acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity, light-colored pixels with granular texture concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textural irregularities and high-contrast clustering at the lobe tips; distinct traumatic or irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
